purpose: Authorize one future-only image-bound v3 E2 lineage from a new all-prior-lineage-excluded OOF pool after P6-first collection passed but rewrite conversion closed below the immutable qualification bar.

evidence.predecessor_result: Collection was 32 selected with no shortfall, but rewrite final was 28 accepted and four terminal quality rejections; conversion qualification is false.
evidence.pool_isolation: 80 readable images, 10 per fixed cell, with zero image/source/near-duplicate overlap against every previous E2 source lineage.
evidence.quality_attribution: The previous P6-first rewrite failures are terminal quality outcomes and excluded from this pool. P6-first selection remains directional sampling evidence only; audit and conversion requirements are unchanged.

future_only_changes.source_selection: Freeze exactly four fresh identities per fixed cell from prescreen-v4 only, after three-key exclusion of all prior E2 sources. Select three P6 class-holdout candidates and one P1 fallback per cell deterministically.

qualification: No threshold is relaxed: 32 unique collection winners, four rows per fixed cell, accepted image-bound rewrite, accepted independent private rewrite audit, and conversion gate are mandatory. SFT remains separately unauthorized.
